g.text: The heavy-component problem remains after a unit repair
Solid: values after PC12–13 unit repair · Dotted: original PC12–13 values · Dashed: table extrapolation

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #993f2b

g.text: PC11 rises sharply in the Twu estimate; PC12–13 use an unsuitable low-reduced-temperature fallback even after units are fixed.

g.text: The literature fractions have no verified mapping to these component IDs. No measured heavy-fraction anchors were transplanted.
